name: tractus
description: Your meetings as local memory for Claude Code: search notes, transcripts, decisions and action items recorded on this Mac with Tractus. Nothing leaves your Mac except what Claude reads.

tractus_bin.title: tractus executable (optional)
tractus_bin.description: Leave empty to find it automatically (the Tractus app in /Applications, the app's settings, or PATH).

tractus_home.title: Tractus data folder (optional)
tractus_home.description: Leave empty to use the folder set in the Tractus app, or ~/Tractus.
